intent: Operators decide how much each platform agent may spend a day without redeploying, within a ceiling the platform fixes.
actor: Operator responsible for the platform's agents
observable_outcome: An operator sets or clears an agent's daily spend cap from the admin workbench with a note; the agent's next run is budgeted against the new cap, and every change is audited.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An override above zero and at most US$5 a day is accepted; zero, one micro past the ceiling, a fraction or a missing cap is refused and changes nothing.
The next run of the agent issues its gateway key from the effective cap, which is the override when set and the defined default otherwise.
Registering the definitions again at worker start replaces only the default and leaves the operator's override in place; clearing the override returns the agent to the default.
Only an operator can change a cap; each change needs a note and writes an audit event with the previous and new effective cap.
